tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · Q3 2026 Unemployment Insurance Tax and Wage Report
tasks.description: Prepare the Q3 2026 Washington unemployment insurance tax and wage report for HANGS Construction Services from 8 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out each employee’s wages and hours, the wages over the 2026 taxable wage base as excess wages, and the tax at the employer’s own rate. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft report. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft UI tax and wage report PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
tasks.periodLine: Q3 2026: July 1–September 30, 2026 · ESD Unemployment Insurance Tax and Wage Report · due November 2, 2026.
